effects.label: Trigger Climax
effects.description: The moment this mark activates, brings the actor to climax at once, overriding any hold.

effects.label: Modify Excitement
effects.description: The moment this mark activates, shifts the actor's arousal by {param1} (a negative value lowers it).

effects.label: Set Excitement
effects.description: The moment this mark activates, sets the actor's arousal to {param1}.

effects.label: Stall Climax
effects.description: Holds the actor back from climaxing while active, releasing them when the mark fades.

effects.label: Set Excitement Multiplier
effects.description: Makes the actor's arousal build {param1} times faster while active.
